schema: CREATE TABLE customers (cid INT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT); CREATE TABLE orders (oid INT, cid INT, amount REAL, PRIMARY KEY (oid, cid), FOREIGN KEY (cid) REFERENCES customers (cid));
correct_query: SELECT COUNT(c.cid) FROM customers AS c INNER JOIN orders AS o ON c.cid = o.cid WHERE o.amount >= 100
